content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

A digital product store with no KYC payments leverages cryptocurrency for transactions, eliminating the need for traditional payment processors that impose high fees and compliance requirements. Platforms like Gumroad charge up to 10% on sales, which significantly cuts into profits. In contrast, using NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5%, allows creators to retain more of their earnings. This architecture matters because it empowers creators to keep control over their revenue and customer data, ensuring they are not reliant on third-party platforms that could restrict access or impose unfavorable terms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The foundational architecture of a no-KYC digital product store consists of several key components. It typically utilizes platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, which are free and reliable. Backend logic can be managed with tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, while order storage can be handled through Supabase or Google Sheets. File delivery is facilitated by Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payment processing happens via NOWPayments, allowing for automatic verification of cryptocurrency transactions. This stack not only minimizes costs but also guarantees that creators maintain ownership of their infrastructure and customer data.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are either unavailable or overly complicated. By adopting this infrastructure, creators can sell a variety of digital products such as ebooks, courses, templates, and software without the fear of payment rejection or excessive fees. It is particularly beneficial for those who wish to sell their work globally, as cryptocurrency transactions can be borderless and instantaneous. This setup is a game-changer for creators looking to build a sustainable income while preserving their independence.
Retain more profit with NOWPayments' 0.5% fee compared to Gumroad's 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The success of a no-KYC digital product store relies on the effective integration of various components. Hosting services like Cloudflare Pages provide a solid foundation, while Cloudflare Workers enable dynamic functionality on the backend. The use of Supabase or Google Sheets ensures efficient order management, and file delivery solutions like Google Drive allow creators to distribute their products effortlessly. NOWPayments ties everything together by offering a simple, low-cost payment processing solution that supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. Together, these elements create a cohesive system that empowers creators to operate independently.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

If you're ready to set up your own no-KYC digital product store, start by choosing your hosting solution, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend functionality using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage orders. Organize your product files in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for delivery. Integrate NOWPayments for seamless cryptocurrency transactions. For those looking for a complete solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all six blueprints and seven templates to help you build, deploy, and scale your store effectively. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.

This allows for low transaction fees and immediate payment processing without the need for KYC verification. Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
